dialogue.text: Martin! Welcome to New York. The city never sleeps, and neither do our deployments.
We've been pushing the boundaries of automated reasoning here. It's a whole new scale.
Remember SRI? We thought that was intense. It was just the warm-up.
Byron's waiting for you. Go talk to him.
Martin! I remember you. The quiet one in Andreas's group in Freiburg. We never really talked, did we?
Let's fix that. Back then I was proving that one loop terminates. Now we're running proofs on the whole cloud.
Automated reasoning, at AWS scale. Ready to join the team?
Take your time. There are still papers lying around the city.
